json.research_summary: Joseph Brady of Main + Main Inc., a company established in 1997, functions as a Marketing and Operations Manager in a real estate firm that may not be fully utilizing existing databases due to the absence of recent marketing pushes and advertised deals. Key pain points include low conversion rates among dormant leads and operational inefficiencies in lead management processes.
json.sequence_strategy: The sequence works by initially addressing Joseph's long-term presence in real estate and hinting at the growing value of existing leads amidst rising costs. It moves from highlighting AI-powered engagement possibilities to proposing a risk-free audit, then transitions to broader applications of AI in operational tasks. It concludes with a breakup email emphasizing industry success and leaving the door open for future communication.
json.hormozi_elements: The emails apply Hormozi elements by hooking with specific references to Joseph's company history and industry longevity, leading with the pain of untapped leads and operational inefficiencies, promising a dream outcome of increased lead conversion without extra spend, de-risking CTAs with a no-cost audit, and fostering curiosity across each message.
json.Email#1 Body:
Hey Joseph,

I noticed Main + Main Inc. has been a staple in real estate since 1997. Impressive longevity!

With rising costs, every lead you've already paid for becomes more valuable. In many firms, old contacts just sit in databases, untouched.

Managing both marketing and operations, you might find reconnecting with dormant leads time-consuming.

We've been working on simplifying this process using AI.

Reply 'YES' if this hits home.

What we've built could surprise you in its simplicity.
json.Email #2 Body:
Hey Joseph,

Picture this: Your existing contacts receive carefully timed emails, texts, and calls. The AI takes care of prompts like budget and timeline inquiries.

Imagine if 10-15% reply ready to re-engage—that's hundreds of warm leads without extra ad spend. Your team stays focused on what they do best.

The system sends, qualifies, and alerts you only when a lead is hot.

Worth a conversation?

This approach isn’t your typical lead rotation trick.
json.Email#2 Subject: The follow-up system Main + Main might need
json.Email#3 Body:
Hey Joseph,

I've reached out a couple times—let’s make this one count.

Send over your old lead list. I'll run it through our AI outreach system at no cost. You’ll get back those showing interest, plus a clear reactivation strategy for Main + Main. No risk, just results up front.

Reply 'AUDIT' to get started.

You’ll see potential without any surprises.
json.Email#4 Body:
Hey Joseph,

I've been focused on reactivating your leads. But I'm curious—what other manual tasks consume your team's hours?

In many firms, scheduling, CRM updates, and initial qualification take up a lot of time.

We create AI agents to streamline these tasks seamlessly. Imagine automatic CRM updates post-call or pre-qualified leads lined up for your team. It's like adding an employee that never rests.

Think it could help Main + Main streamline processes?

Spending time on essentials only can drive real growth.
json.Email#4 Subject: Joseph—AI for more than just leads
